title: Additional Adzuna capabilities (entitled operations as bounded tools)
coverage_note: Declares a bounded, allow-listed set of ADDITIONAL Adzuna operations beyond the existing current-vacancy search, each with strict parameter bounds, an entitlement requirement and a safe-output shape. This phase delivers the bounded SPEC + parameter validation + quota/failure/security handling deterministically; live provider calls remain UNVALIDATED and cost-gated (never called by default). Operations not on this allow-list are rejected.

operations.description: Advertised-salary distribution for a role in a country (histogram buckets).
Companies advertising most for a role in a country.
Advertised-vacancy counts by occupation category in a country.
Advertised-vacancy counts by region for a role in a country.

safety_rules: Advertised-market data is self-reported job-board data, NOT official observed earnings.
Every result must be labelled with provider and self_reported_note where salary is involved.
Operations outside this allow-list are rejected; parameters outside declared bounds are rejected.
Requires the declared entitlement; unentitled callers are refused.
Quota-limited; a quota breach returns a safe rate-limited status, never an error stack.
